claims.text: Displacement is not uniform across racial lines. [Source: ev-1]

Additionally, educational attainment has shifted toward urban centers, where 35% of residents hold bachelor’s degrees or higher, compared to 31% in suburbs and 19% in rural area [Source: ev-1].

**Structural Economic Shifts**
The four-decade transformation was fueled by a shift away from manufacturing toward service industries. [Source: ev-1]
Manufacturing jobs fell from 19.5 million in 1979 to under 11.5 million during the pandemic, while finance and professional services grew from 12 million to 32 million job [Source: ev-1].
This concentration of high-income professionals in urban cores has intensified inequality. [Source: ev-1]

Since 1980, nearly 80% of the country's population growth among those under 45 was concentrated in metro areas with over 1 million residents, as urban counties gained prime-age workers (ages 25–54) while rural counties lost them [Source: ev-1].
